REL-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.claim: An encountered statement of the prevalence of one specified behavior in a named referent group may shift a recipient's subsequently reported estimate of that same behavior's prevalence toward the stated value.
REL-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.scope: Controlled or field communication to adults, with verified encounter, same behavior and referent group, prior estimate, comparator without the prevalence statement, and measured later perceived descriptive prevalence.
REL-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.timing: After verified message encounter within the study's follow-up window; no long-term persistence asserted.
boundaries: INF-061 is the message claim, PSY-016 is the recipient's subjective estimate, neither is the actual Social norm.
Message credibility, prior estimate, true-versus-stated prevalence, behavior and referent-group match are conditions.
No behavioral, injunctive-norm, or universal population transfer claim.
Personalized feedback packages may include own-behavior comparisons and are not isolated evidence for the content-property edge.
REL-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.skepticalReason: The cleanest field message states neighbors' plans while the outcome estimates actual visits; other studies use personalized feedback bundles. The exact general content-property edge is not yet isolated across independent settings.
